close_reason: fixed: limit=0 without calculateTotal skips collapseThreads fetch entirely
description: When collapseThreads=true and the client sends limit=0 (meaning 'return no results'), Email/query still fetches up to COLLAPSE_THREADS_MAX_EMAILS+1 (65537) email IDs from the backend before applying the limit (email.rs lines 665-725). The 'page' slice is then .take(0), returning an empty array — correct result, but the backend fetch was wasteful and unnecessary. More importantly, if limit=0 is an intentional client pattern (e.g. to get just the total count with calculateTotal=true), the total is computed correctly from the collapsed IDs. However, the large backend fetch can cause performance issues. RFC 8620 §5.5 permits limit=0 as a valid request. This is a performance/correctness boundary issue: total is correct, but the over-fetch is unexpected for a limit=0 request.
title: Email/query: limit=0 in collapseThreads path fetches COLLAPSE_THREADS_MAX_EMAILS+1 items unnecessarily
